import sys,time,random,resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp');sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
from cost_scaling import solve_assignment
random.seed(2)
R=int(sys.argv[1]);O=int(sys.argv[2]);P=int(sys.argv[3])
pairs=[];seen=set()
while len(pairs)<P:
    i=random.randrange(R);j=random.randrange(O)
    if (i,j) in seen:continue
    seen.add((i,j));pairs.append((i,j,random.randrange(0,10**9)))
t=time.time();flow,dt,rounds,G,price=solve_assignment(R,O,pairs,costmax=10**9)
print('R,O,P',R,O,P,'flow',len(flow),'time',dt,'rounds',rounds,'total',time.time()-t,'rss',resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss)
EOF
